body.title: Full terminal-envelope capacity gates
body.summary: Preflight and requalify complete checkpoint and CR envelopes using real serializers, shared bounded failure factory and remaining terminal reserve.
acceptanceChecks: Before admission save/ACK/provider qualify failed and incomplete 4 MiB envelopes including prior history, tasks, snapshots, diagnostics/repair/completion metadata and escaped pretty JSON.
Store shared failure once with code <=64 and summary <=8192 UTF-8 bytes; preserve 32 KiB diagnostics policy, no trimming/dropping to fit.
Check actual accepted mapping before save and later result/diagnostic growth against remaining terminal reserve; external/storage conflicts explicit.
Reject oversized 10000-task small-input unit before save/model; exact-fit admitted units can fail attribution, publish all outcomes and permit next attempt.

tests.name: Actual pretty checkpoint and merged CR serializers qualify failed/incomplete terminal reserves including all tasks, prior history, mapping/decisions, diagnostics and completion metadata before save/ACK/provider.
Exercise 10000-task small-input overflow, exact-fit/one-byte-over, long IDs and escaped/Unicode diagnostics at unchanged 32 KiB aggregate policy with shared bounded failure detail.

Both routes preserve terminal reserve through accepted mapping and later results/diagnostics; capacity-boundary attribution failure publishes all outcomes and permits next attempt; oversized work dispatches/saves nothing.
